mcp_tools.name: framework_adoption_adr
mcp_tools.title: Framework adoption adr
mcp_tools.description: Submits a framework-adoption ADR record (the adoption decision and candidate fit assessments, house-stack conformity, pinning and upgrades, runtime explicitness, plugins and deprecations) and returns a deterministic FRAMEWORK_ADOPTION_SOUND / FRAMEWORK_ADOPTION_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed candidate-fit and plugin-compliance coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared adoption record; it adopts nothing.

inputSchema.description: The framework-adoption ADR manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

candidates.description: Declared candidates: {name, team_familiarity_assessed, maintenance_health_assessed, ecosystem_assessed, performance_assessed, exit_cost_assessed, selected}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid; computed_spot_checks: candidates_count=1, selected_count=1, fit_assessment_coverage=1.000000
